caption_en:
Perfect innovation: 100. Israel: 52, 14th of 139 countries (WIPO Global Innovation Index 2025).

What's in the gap? Nobody is close to 100: Switzerland is 1st with 66, and 13 countries beat Israel.

Zoom out, same scale: 🇮🇱 Israel 52, 🇦🇪 UAE 44, 🇹🇷 Turkey 37, 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia 36, 🇶🇦 Qatar 35, 🇯🇴 Jordan 30, 🇮🇷 Iran 29, 🇪🇬 Egypt 25. The last country on the list: 11.9.

Honest catch: Switzerland is still 14 points ahead of us.

We're not perfect. But "builds nothing"? We're closer to utopia than anyone around us.

Send this to a critic.
caption_he:
חדשנות מושלמת: 100. ישראל: 52, מקום 14 מתוך 139 במדד החדשנות העולמי.
בפער: אף אחד לא קרוב. שווייץ ראשונה עם 66, ו־13 מדינות לפנינו.
זום אאוט: האמירויות 44, טורקיה 37, סעודיה 36, קטאר 35, ירדן 30, איראן 29, מצרים 25. המקום האחרון ברשימה: 11.9.
ובכנות: שווייץ עדיין 14 נקודות לפנינו.
לא מושלמים. אבל "לא בונים כלום"? הכי קרובים לאוטופיה באזור.

Source: WIPO Global Innovation Index 2025.

lines.line: This is perfect innovation. Israel is here.
Fifty-two out of a hundred. Fourteenth of a hundred and thirty-nine countries.
What's in the gap? Nobody gets close. Switzerland is first, with sixty-six.
Now zoom out. They say Israel builds nothing. It only destroys.
Building nothing looks like this: twelve, the bottom of the list.
The Emirates, forty-four. Turkey, thirty-seven. Saudi Arabia, thirty-six. Qatar, thirty-five. Jordan, thirty. Iran, twenty-nine. Egypt, twenty-five.
One honest catch: Switzerland is still fourteen points ahead of us.
We're not perfect. We know it.
But builds nothing? We're closer to utopia than anyone around us.
